name: Gemma-4-31B-it SRT-Sunstone
description: A read-out that reads images — trained only on words

paragraphs: SRT Sunstone is a live demonstration that a read-out head trained on text alone can interpret images — with zero image training. It is a 12.3 M side-channel head on a frozen google/gemma-4-31B-it, taught one thing from prose: to tell apart communities of language use. Point it at a picture and it names what the image means and the discourse it evokes.

This is the semiotic claim of the SRT (Semiotic-Reflexive Transformer) program made concrete: the read-out interprets a sign by its place in a shared system of meaning, independent of whether the sign arrived as a word or an image.
Pick any category in the gallery. For each one you see:
features: The words it means — the image, placed in a shared word space, retrieves
The caption it retrieves — the same image state picks a full sentence
The discourse it evokes — the nearest of 35 discourse communities the head
